problem:
Consider the highlighted entry of the matrix $Y$ given below. Describe it in terms of ${y}_{ij}.$

$$
Y=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ -4 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution: The entry lies at the intersection of the $4$th row and $2$nd column. Hence, we have ${y}_{42}=7.$
